svg.title: Stop the sequence prediction where its evidence stops
svg.desc: The explicitly supplied coding-region RNA5′-AUG GAA UUU UAA-3′ yields methionine,glutamate,phenylalanine and then termination under the standard code and stated start frame. The peptide is Met–Glu–Phe, with no fourth stop amino acid. The diagram distinguishes immediate sequence prediction from folding, processing, protein amount, activity and cellular phenotype. An amino-acid change can have varied effects depending on context, and abundant RNA with little stable protein can arise from translation or degradation differences. It does not infer an organism phenotype or translate later sequence beyond the stop.

g.text: Stop the sequence prediction where its evidence stops
A correctly translated chain still needs evidence about expression, folding and activity.
Stated complete coding-region model: 5′-AUG GAA UUU UAA-3′
Immediate peptide: Met–Glu–Phe. Stop contributes no fourth amino acid.
Sequence → folding/processing → activity → cellular effect are separate inference steps.
Compare protein amount and function; a missense change is not automatically harmful.
Abundant RNA with low protein can reflect slow translation or fast breakdown.
Do not translate beyond the stop in this reading frame or infer whole-protein function from this fragment.
